Name: CaveGuns Mod
Author: xc333222
Description:
[color=#ff0000]This mod is a large firearms expansion mod, adding a series of guns, ammunition, workbenches, weapons, outfits, functional blocks, decorative blocks, grenades, rocket launchers, and more to Stardew Valley. [/color]

The content of this mod does not require any prerequisite mods—you can use it as soon as you add it. There is a 'Pack' folder in the mod folder, which is where the gun pack files are stored. By default, it already includes all the latest official gun packs, and you can also add more gun packs or make your own. The gun modification and creation tools have been uploaded as well.

Currently included gun packs:
- German Gun Pack
- East Asian Gun Pack
- British & American Gun Pack
- Soviet Gun Pack
- Default Gun Pack

[color=#00ffff]I also made an extra visual editor for creating and modifying firearms. Here's the download link—through it, you can directly create or open an existing firearm content pack to modify anything.[/color]

[color=#ff0000]But it only supports Chinese.[/color]

[color=#f4cccc]Editor Link[/color]:[url=https://github.com/xc333222/CaveGuns]xc333222/CaveGuns: CaveGuns[/url]


In total, there are 100 guns, 20 types of ammo, 10 melee weapons, 15 national flag barbed wire items, 10 grenades, and other stuff like rocket launchers.

If you like this mod, be sure to follow us on BiliBili~

[i]Enjoy your game~[/i]
